notes.title: Berserk or Die patch 1.0.2 now live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone - I'm pleased to say we have another patch ready for Berserk or Die!



This update focuses on making control schemes more flexible and easier to understand for new players, plus a few quality of life tweaks



Added a drop-down menu in the option for selecting the preferred input method, so that the game doesn't switch input mid-gameplay, hopefully creating less confusion for players



Updated the Tutorial stage, letting the player choose which input method to try out in the tutorial



Updated the character selection input screen to showcase the selected input method and not everything at once



Added a Keyboard (simple) input mode, that's thought for people that have trouble with keyboard rollout issues (meaning they can't input more than X amount of keys simultaneously)



Updated the bargain in the peddler to showcase the % chance of bargaining the prices and the resulting discount if said bargain is successful



Added a visual indicator to the buckets/barrels projectile in the Samurai House stage



Reduced the background elements in the Forest stage for better visibility



Solved an issue where the Phalanx boss wouldn't be correctly defeated if certain specials were used



Improved visibility of the Girl when playing the Demon of Discord, so that now she has an outline when hidden by foreground or background elements



Solved an issue where wireless/bluetooth controllers weren't recognized properly



Mouse and Keyboard / Keyboard only / Mouse only / Controller now have a "Simple" and a "Berserk" control scheme variant, one is for ease of play and one is for going full Berserk or Die!



The training ground (tutorial stage) now has an input selection menu at the beginning of the stage, letting the player choose their preferred control scheme



When a controller is connected for the first time, a menu is opened, asking players to select between the "Simple" or "Berserk" control scheme for controller



There will be another patch following this one very soon, which will add even more flexibility to the game's control methods. In the meantime, check out our character breakdown video which gives tips and tricks on each character in the game!



Thank you!

notes.title: Berserk or Die hotfix 1.0.1 now live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are gathered here today to remember and celebrate the [strike]lives of our neon gaming keyboards[/strike] launch of Nao Games' Berserk or Die!

It's been great to see such positive reception, watch people play even more unconventionally than expected, and read all the 3wapo3pfwjofwoj comments and reviews.

We're also amazed to say we sold 10,000 copies of the game in the first 24 hours, so thank you so much for all your support since we launched last week!


Huge thanks also directly from Shibata-san of Nao Games, who's very keen on listening to your feedback too:
"This time, we focused mainly on fixing bugs.

We were only able to respond to requests to open a lot of loot, but next time we will respond to as many requests as possible."


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/ef48a90e402dabf584349a90965d122c86e28c49.png"]




Hotfix now live
We've been listening to your feedback across Steam and poncle's social channels and have been working on new features, especially about alternative control schemes, but in the meantime we're also releasing  some quick fixes with patch 1.0.1:

Fixed enemies getting stuck in Samurai Residence

Fixed some bosses disappearing when left alone for too long

Fixes for characters occasionally getting stuck below the terrain

Fixed boss defeat checkmarks

Added an Open All button in the Armory screen

Improved visibility in Forest stage

Revised wording for unlock conditions on the character selection screen

Exiting a run will send you to the results screen now

Other minor fixes
    
Original soundtrack out now
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732020/Berserk_or_Die_Soundtrack/?"][/dynamiclink]

You can now listen to all 16 tracks from Berserk or Die whenever you like, each composed by Filippo Vicarelli, a name you may recognise from poncle's own Vampire Survivors. There are 7 full BGM tracks from Berserk or Die, plus 9 Short tracks such as jingles, titles, and shop themes. We're also in the process of uploading the full soundtrack on Youtube:
[previewyoutube="si3_G-UBdLU;full"][/previewyoutube]



Community items now available
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/000f159a53812766e83ffcfc7129056fef275c5a.png"]Steam trading cards and community items are now available, we got the usual package of:

4x profile backgrounds

6x badges

5x trading cards

11x emoticons

You can learn more about Trading Cards here



Coming in the next patch
From the next update you'll be able to switch control scheme easily, get a tutorial for these new schemes, and play with:
[olist]
Default (Mouse + Keyboard)

Keyboard Only

Mouse Only

Gamepad
[/olist]




Thank you all again and please stay tuned for more Berserk or Die updates very soon!

notes.title: [preview version] Save Data moved
notes.notes:
For anyone playing the preview version of the game who wants to keep their save data after launch, please follow the following steps:

1) Open the install location of Berserk or Die (right click the game title from the Steam Library, then Manage > Browse local files

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/3cacc142ec23d059a267f1ccfa7b514a4f4bba46.png"]



2) Copy these files from the "BeaserkorDie_Data" folder
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/36c2d29d717794bfbc194b292b112bf1588484f1.png"]


3) Paste them into "BerserkorDie_Data" folder

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/6fd52536bc87fb9463b20f2178e2b76b685e4c96.png"]



Now launch the game and your old save data will be loaded. Please just send a message on the forum if you need any help, thank you!
